facts.text: The Cranberry Investment guarantees that Rider University undergraduate students who fulfill their responsibilities will obtain an entry-level job related to their field of study or be accepted into graduate or professional school within six months of graduation.

sources.quote: The Cranberry Investment guarantees that Rider's undergraduate students who fulfill their responsibilities will obtain an entry-level job related to their field of study or be accepted into graduate or professional school within six months of graduation.

facts.text: Through the Cranberry Investment, Rider offers career coaching or up to nine free credits for eligible students if they are still seeking employment or graduate school placement six months after graduation.

sources.title: Transfer Information for Academic Advisors - Rider University
sources.quote: Through the Cranberry Investment, Rider even offers career coaching or up to nine free credits for eligible students if they're still seeking employment or grad school placement six months after graduation.

facts.text: Every Rider student is required to complete at least two high-impact Engaged Learning experiences, such as study abroad or guided research, to satisfy their graduation requirements.
